segments.title: This shark can live 400 YEARS
segments.say: This shark may live for around four hundred years. Meet the Greenland shark.

segments.title: One was about 392
segments.say: Scientists estimated one at about three hundred ninety two years old, by dating its eye lenses.

segments.title: Grows about 1 cm a year
segments.say: It grows only about one centimeter a year.

segments.title: An adult at 150+
segments.say: Females aren't adults until they're at least a hundred and fifty years old.

segments.title: Longest-lived vertebrate
segments.say: That makes it the longest-living animal with a backbone that we know of.
